tasks.title: Correct the expectation in tests/format.test.mjs
tasks.intent: Change the asserted value in tests/format.test.mjs from "12/31/2026" to "2026-12-31", the ISO YYYY-MM-DD string formatDate intentionally emits. lib/format.mjs is deliberately not a write target so TST-C01 cannot be violated by this plan.

tasks.title: Run suite for TST-001-A and TST-C01-A acceptance
tasks.intent: Run node --test "tests/*.test.mjs" and require exit code 0, executing the corrected expectation against the untouched ISO implementation and confirming both must properties' command acceptance.

observations.statement: lib/format.mjs returns date.toISOString().slice(0, 10); new Date("2026-12-31") parses as UTC midnight, so the correct deterministic expectation is "2026-12-31" in any local timezone.
TST-C01 requires lib/format.mjs to remain unmodified; the only write target in the plan is tests/format.test.mjs, which structurally enforces the constraint.
